title: MentraOS miniapp manifest
description: Manifest schema for a Mentra miniapp (miniapp.json)

description.description: Short description shown in the store / dev tools

icon.description: Path or URL to the app icon (e.g. icon.png)

port.description: Port the dev server listens on (default 3000)

minHostVersion.description: Semver of the lowest MentraOS Manager host version that can run this bundle. The host re-validates this on every install and after host upgrades; bundles that no longer meet the bar are disabled (not deleted) with a clear UI.

minApiLevel.description: API level of the @mentra/miniapp SDK this bundle was built with. Written by `pack` and `dev`; the Mentra App refuses a bundle above its own level and asks to be updated.

entry.description: Two-layer bundle entry points. Background is the always-running JSContext entry; UI is the on-demand WebView entry.

background.description: Path to the background bundle, relative to the bundle root (e.g. background/index.js). Required for V2+ two-layer bundles.

ui.description: Path to the UI bundle entry HTML, relative to the bundle root (e.g. ui/index.html). Optional  -- pure-background miniapps don't need a WebView.

type.description: Miniapp type. 'standard' includes a UI WebView; 'background' is JSContext-only. Defaults to 'standard'.

permissions.description: Phone permissions the miniapp needs to declare

required.description: If false, the permission is optional. Defaults to required at runtime.

description.description: User-facing reason this permission is needed (shown in OS prompts)

hardwareRequirements.description: Glasses hardware capabilities the miniapp needs

level.description: REQUIRED hides the app on glasses without it; OPTIONAL still lets it run

description.description: How the miniapp uses this hardware

configuration.description: Managed settings a deployment or a workspace admin may set, read with session.configuration. Values are read-only on the phone.

setBy.description: Who may set it besides the shipped default: deployment (the default), workspace, person. backendUrl is deployment only.

merge.description: For a list: append keeps every layer's items.

default.description: The shipped value, used when no deployment or workspace sets one.

fields.description: For a list: the fields of each item.

actions.description: Actions other (system) miniapps can invoke via session.actions. Maps 1:1 onto MCP tools.

id.description: Unique-within-app action id (lowercase, starts with a letter).

description.description: AI-facing contract  -- say when to use the action.

parameters.description: JSON-Schema input descriptor (the MCP inputSchema subset).

outputSchema.description: JSON-Schema descriptor for the structured action result (MCP outputSchema).

lifecycle.description: Action lifecycle. 'persistent' opens or preserves normal user-visible activity; 'transient' may run in an invisible context that is released after the invocation.

audience.description: Who may invoke the action. Host actions are omitted from miniapp action discovery.
